bottom_line: Stocks just had their worst week since 2020, led by a crash in AI and tech stocks. And the Fed, the people who set interest rates, looks set to RAISE rates in December to fight inflation instead of cutting them to help.

stories.title: AI stocks crash, market follows
stories.real: The S&P 500 sank 3.7%, the Nasdaq wiped out all its 2026 gains, and the S&P and Dow fell into a 'correction,' which means a big drop from their recent highs. Nvidia plunged 14% and finished its longest weekly losing streak since 2008. It went from the world's most valuable company to fourth, behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO lands in the storm
stories.real: Anthropic, the AI company, had a record IPO, meaning its first day selling shares to the public on the Nasdaq. Then its shares slid along with the rest of tech. Critics are also asking whether being a public company will push it to put profits ahead of safety.
stories.you: A big, hyped debut doesn't protect a new stock from falling when the whole sector it belongs to sells off.

stories.title: Fed is leaning toward a rate hike
stories.real: Notes from the Fed's last meeting say higher rates are needed in December because inflation is still a problem. Fed Governor Lisa Cook said one hike may not be enough. Fed officials also warned that the AI spending boom is adding to inflation risk.
stories.you: Higher rates mean credit card, car loan and other borrowing costs can go up, and the Fed isn't going to step in to rescue falling stocks while it fights prices.

stories.title: Trump pushes the Fed to cut
stories.real: President Trump says interest rates are too high and the Fed has become 'politicized.' He pointed to India as an example and again pushed the Fed to lower rates. That is the opposite of what Fed officials say they plan to do.
stories.you: This tug-of-war is noise for now. The Fed, not the White House, sets rates, and the Fed is signaling a hike.

stories.title: Tanker attacks near oil route
stories.real: A UK maritime agency reported two tanker attacks near Oman. Iran says a vessel hit a mine east of the Strait of Hormuz. This came after another tanker near Khasab caught fire on Friday.
stories.you: Much of the world's oil moves through this area, so trouble there is something to watch for gas and energy prices.
